note: Verbatim quotations cited to an UNVERSIONED arxiv.org/abs/ page (beads addictedtoai-2xh). Each is a DEBT, not an exemption: it warns on every build and the check fails the moment a new one appears. This list has one legal direction, down. Every entry here was measured on 2026-08-31 to be ABSENT from the cited paper's current abstract, after ruling out the comparison itself (case, arXiv's `--` for an em dash, a quotation ending in a comma where the source has a full stop, single vs double quote marks). They are therefore quotations from the paper's BODY, not its abstract, and export.arxiv.org's API cannot confirm them. Pinning them to the current version would assert a provenance nobody checked, which is the one thing this repository forbids more firmly than leaving a debt recorded. Repay by verifying each against that version's full text and then pinning; addictedtoai-vt2 carries that work. The 40 sites whose quotations WERE verified present in the abstract were pinned rather than recorded here.
method: export.arxiv.org/api/query?id_list=<id> (the version suffix is honoured; verified by checking the returned <id> ends in the requested vN). Literal substring match against the returned <summary> bytes, normalised only for whitespace, case, unicode dashes and quote marks, and trailing punctuation.
